action.objective: Castle queenside to safeguard the king and complete development.
action.rationale: e1c1 is the sole commit_ready move: verified exact at depth 3 (-55), safety.complete true, no mate-in-one or checking-chain refutation, and no Black forcing mate found. Broad depth-3 search favored castling (-55) over c2c3/c2c4 (-76). It activates the rook and removes the king from the center. Remaining analysis budget is reserved/unavailable for another candidate, so this strongest exact evidence stands.
